uncited: The method operates on tile-wise or primitive-level bounding boxes.
**Approximate Intersection Test:** Perform an intersection test between the view frustum (or camera ray) and the bounding box.
**Fragment Generation:** Pass the "visible" primitives to the rasterizer.
The method does not introduce new mathematical formulas for compositing but modifies the culling condition.
